lesson.menu_desc: Keep talking when the word goes -- who, which, that, where -- 28 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 11 -- When the Word Disappears
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Mauricio | Lesson 11 -- When the Word Disappears

listenings.text: Every year, on the first morning, somebody comes to me and says the same thing. My English is fine until I need one specific word, and then it disappears, and I stop. Here is what I tell them. Native speakers lose words too. It happens to me three or four times a day. The difference is that we do not stop. We describe the thing. It is the person who signs the contracts. It is the report that shows the numbers every month. It is the place where the money comes in. Nobody in that room is waiting for the perfect word. They are waiting for the idea. So when the word goes, do not go silent and do not apologize. Say hold on, describe it, and keep moving.

On my first day in the program, I tried to explain our credit process and I got stuck on one word. I knew it in my own language. I knew it was there. And I stood there for maybe ten seconds, which feels like ten minutes. That night I wrote four sentences on a small card and put it in my pocket. Hold on. It is sort of like. It is the thing that. What I mean is. The next day the word disappeared again, in the middle of a case. I took a breath, said it is the money that the client cannot pay back, and the professor said, right, the default rate, and wrote it on the board. Nobody remembered that I forgot the word. They remembered the point.

items.situation: You are explaining your budget and you forget the word for the money a company makes in a year. Keep going.
You need to describe a person on your team whose job has no simple English name.
tips: He is sort of like a ...

items.situation: You said something badly and the room looks confused. Say it again, better.
The word is on the tip of your tongue and six people are waiting. Do not go silent.
tips: It is on the tip of my tongue ...

items.situation: Somebody uses a word you do not know. Check the meaning with a description.
tips: I will look it up later.
